why: The two texts differ in exactly one character's case, inside an environment value. The encoder's tokenizer is uncased, so the two blocks embed to BYTE-IDENTICAL vectors and score 1.0000 -- tied with a genuine paraphrase in positive_paraphrase/ at exactly the same number. No value of tau can refuse it without refusing that paraphrase too. It is also the evidence behind Phase 10.4's case-folding decision: if normalize_for_hash folded case, this pair would collide at Tier 0, where no guard runs at all.
